name: Tumor necrosis factor
summary: TNF encodes tumor necrosis factor alpha, a pro-inflammatory cytokine central to innate immunity and the acute-phase response. TNF-alpha activates NF-kB, MAPK, and apoptotic signaling cascades. The TNF-308G>A (rs1800629) promoter polymorphism increases transcriptional activity and TNF-alpha production. Elevated TNF-alpha levels are implicated in asthma, COPD, rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, and cardiovascular inflammation. Gene-environment interactions with PM2.5 and tobacco smoke amplify airway inflammation in carriers of the high-expression allele.

regulatory_notes.promoter_activity: TNF-308A allele increases promoter activity 2-3 fold; responsive to NF-kB, AP-1, and NFAT transcription factors.
regulatory_notes.methylation_sensitivity: Promoter methylation inversely correlated with TNF expression in airway epithelium.

mechanistic_hypotheses.hypothesis: TNF-308A carriers produce higher TNF-alpha levels under PM2.5 exposure, amplifying NF-kB-driven airway inflammation and increasing asthma susceptibility in exposed populations.
mechanistic_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Islam et al. EHP 2014; Li et al. Environ Toxicol Pharmacol 2017.

references.title: GSTP1 and TNF Gene Variants and Associations between Air Pollution and Incident Childhood Asthma
The role of TNF-alpha in asthma

ancestry_context.allele_frequency_note: TNF-308A allele frequency: ~20% European, ~10% East Asian, ~15% African-ancestry. Effect on TNF-alpha levels consistent across ancestries.
